name: SH-I-048A
summary: SH-I-048A (SH-i-048A) is a benzodiazepine derivative related in structure to compounds such as flubromazepam and meclonazepam.11 nM at α5. It has been used to study the functional differences between the different subtypes of the GABAA receptor.

pharmacology.text: SH-I-048A is described as a non subtype selective superagonist at the benzodiazepine site of GABAA receptors, with a binding affinity of 0.77 nM at the α1 subtype, 0.17 nM at α2, 0.38 nM at α3 and 0.11 nM at α5. It has been used to study the functional differences between the different subtypes of the GABAA receptor.

uses.text: It has been used to study the functional differences between the different subtypes of the GABAA receptor.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and dependence, and stopping after regular use can bring a dangerous withdrawal with seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題與依賴，長期使用後突然停藥可能出現危險的戒斷反應，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题与依赖，长期使用后突然停药可能出现危险的戒断反应，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is a close structural cousin of the designer benzodiazepines flubromazepam and meclonazepam, and its molecule carries both a bromine and a fluorine atom.
fact.zh: 它在結構上與設計型苯二氮平類藥物flubromazepam和meclonazepam很接近，分子中同時帶有一個溴原子和一個氟原子。
fact.zhHans: 它在结构上与设计型苯二氮平类药物flubromazepam和meclonazepam很接近，分子中同时带有一个溴原子和一个氟原子。
